thread:
lee: Heads-up: after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak we see a localized drop in prefix cache hit-rate for model-4 on route /summarize, mostly for customers in EU region. Dash shows token-saved down ~38% for a few tenants. Anyone digging into why the warmup keys stopped matching?
maria: Yup noticed. Kernel change bumped chunking heuristics -> different attention tiling. That changed sequence-length bucketing which affected key normalization. :grimacing:
xander: Can you paste the dashboard link? also posting quick PromQL I used to slice by tenant: `sum by(tenant) (increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[7d])) / sum by(tenant) (increase(prefix_cache_lookups_total[7d]))` — gives hit-rate per tenant.
lee: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/abc123/prefix-hit-explorer?orgId=1&var-model=model-4&var-route=%2Fsummarize&from=now-7d to=now
lee: example tenant IDs: tenant-A, tenant-B, tenant-C. tenant-A hit-rate collapsed from 0.72 -> 0.44 around 2026-03-15 03:00 UTC.
maria: I ran a small profile on the runtime: kernel selector now prefers small-matmul path for seq<128. For route /summarize most warmup keys were generated under seq=160 previously, now they map to seq=120 -> different key fingerprint because we include sequence-bucket in key. Patch in #4021 removed seq-bucket from key for other routes but not this one (oops).
xander: that explains warmup miss. Options: revert kernel change, or change keying to be length-agnostic for prompt prefix keys. My preference: make keying tolerant + add fallback that checks adjacent buckets within 1 bucket. Cheap to implement.
sara: infra-bot flagged increased token spend on Dedicated pools for those tenants, costing ~ $1.2k extra/day. We need mitigation before EOD.
lee: Can we add a temporary routing rule: if model==model-4 and route==/summarize, force kernel-selector to old path for EU region? That buys time.
maria: I'll open a short-lived feature-flag: `prefetch.len_bucketless` false for model-4 + /summarize in EU. Deploying now.
infra-bot: [ALERT] Route /summarize (model-4, eu-west) prefix_cache_hit_rate dropped below 50% for tenants: tenant-A, tenant-B at 2026-03-15T03:12:10Z. Pager: #oncall-eng-runtime.
xander: Added dashboard panel: "token_saved_by_tenant (7d rolling)" and a heatmap for seq-bucket vs hit-rate. Query attached in panel description.
lee: After FF flip, initial checks show tenant-A back to 0.69 hit-rate. Token-saved trending up. Thanks. Need follow-up: 1) keying invariant doc update, 2) add unit test comparing warmup-key normalization across kernel selector variants, 3) long-term: remove seq-bucket dependence in cache key where prefix is semantic (not positional).
maria: I'll handle 1 & 2. xander can you take 3 as a small design doc?
xander: Yup, will put an ADR and include perf estimates (expected +10-15% hit-rate uplift for mixed-length routes).
sara: I'll file a billing check to reconcile extra spend and mark cost code. :thumbsup:
lee: Great. If anyone sees other tenants noisy, reply here with tenant id + snapshot. Closing asap.
